subject: Fossil Fuel Divestment Support
overview: The Council supported state fossil fuel divestment legislation and increased the income limit for the senior property tax deferment program to $50,000. It also referred several COVID-19 housing stability proposals to subcommittee and requested clarification on emergency orders regarding property showings.

items.title: Public Hearing on Anne Bakery Special Permit (Paper 20-084)
items.summary: Approved a special permit for Anne Bakery at 17 Playstead Road to extend hours of operation to 6:00 a.m. daily, with conditions limiting the permit to the current business and requiring a 90-day review.

items.title: Senior Tax Deferment Income Limit (Paper 20-042)
items.summary: Approved increasing the annual income limit for the senior property tax deferment program to $50,000 for fiscal year 2021 and requested that the administration include tax exemption information in future bill mailings.

items.title: Support for Fossil Fuel Divestment Legislation (Paper 20-288)
items.summary: Approved a resolution supporting Massachusetts House Bill 4440 to authorize local retirement systems to divest from fossil fuels despite concerns from some members regarding the autonomy of retirement boards.

items.title: Business License and Commendation (Papers 20-309, 20-298)
items.summary: Approved a resolution congratulating Mystic Coffee Roaster on its 10th anniversary and granted a common victualler license to Hot Chicks Halal at 49 High Street contingent on a final fire inspection.

items.title: COVID-19 Information Dissemination (Paper 20-299)
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the city administration collaborate with the council to create a unified coronavirus information sheet for delivery to residents and small businesses.

items.title: Housing Stability Task Force and Eviction Moratorium (Papers 20-300, 20-302)
items.summary: Referred proposals to establish a housing stability task force and an emergency eviction moratorium to the Elderly and Housing Affairs Subcommittee for further study.

items.title: Emergency Order Clarification on Property Showings (Paper 20-301)
items.summary: Referred a request to the city administration for clarification on whether unoccupied housing units may be shown to prospective tenants or buyers under current COVID-19 executive orders.

items.title: Rental Assistance Funding (Paper 20-306)
items.summary: Approved a resolution calling on the Commonwealth to increase contributions to the Residential Assistance for Families in Transition (RAFT) fund to address the economic impacts of the pandemic.

items.title: Peer Consultants and 40B Development (Paper 20-308)
items.summary: Approved a request for the administration to provide an update on the hiring of peer architects and engineers to assist the city during the 40B housing development process.

items.title: Committee Reports and Zoning Update
items.summary: Approved committee reports regarding the zoning consultant search, sign ordinance amendments, and council rules; the council also requested a list of all consultants hired since the change in administration.
